Overview

Most Cyber & Zero-Trust for AgriFinance & Commodity Markets programs fail the same way: a pilot that impresses on a demo dataset and then dissolves when it meets farm management systems, exception handling and audit. We start from the production seams instead — the queues, the exception lanes, the reconciliation breaks — and engineer those first. Agriculture & Food Systems punishes generic deployments. yield per hectare moves faster than batch cycles, EU deforestation rules demands evidence chains most tools cannot produce, and the estate is heterogeneous — which is why every engagement starts with the seams named above rather than a platform-first rollout.
